plugins.name: Wallhaven
plugins.author: Ryoku Team
plugins.tagline: Browse wallhaven.cc and set your wallpaper, from any host.
plugins.description: A full wallpaper browser for the Ryoku desktop. Search wallhaven.cc, filter by Latest / Top week / Top month, page through results, and set any wallpaper with a click. Renders as a frame popout that melts out of the screen edge, or as a draggable desktop widget alongside your clock and weather - the same view, native in either home.
